commands.shell:
Usage: coderadar shell [OPTIONS]

  REPL with persistent graph in memory.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
commands.watch:
Usage: coderadar watch [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

  Watch files for changes and auto-update the code graph.

  PATHS: directories to watch (default: src/ tests/). With --git, a ref
  watcher runs the commit-driven sync instead (`ops.sync_git`).

Options:
  --debounce INTEGER  Debounce window in ms
  --git               Follow git refs instead of files: ingest commits and
                      sweep checkouts (P5d).
  --help              Show this message and exit.
commands.context:
Usage: coderadar-rs context QUERY [OPTIONS]

  Build a token-budgeted GraphRAG context (MCP coderadar_context).

Options:
  --budget INTEGER  Token budget for the rendered context.  [default: 8192]
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.visualize:
Usage: coderadar visualize [OPTIONS] VIZ_TYPE [ARGS]...

  Run a visualizer: hierarchy, dependencies, call-graph.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH
  --format TEXT
  --help             Show this message and exit.
commands.rebuild-store:
Usage: coderadar rebuild-store [OPTIONS]

  Rebuild a store from git plus its exported annotations (P8, A-9/INV-18).

Options:
  --repo TEXT                 Git repository the history is read from.
                              [default: .]
  --store TEXT                Store file to rebuild (default:
                              <repo>/.coderadar/store/coderadar.db).
  --branches TEXT             Comma-separated branches (default: the D-6 c
                              selection, trunk first).
  --parent-ref TEXT           Trunk ref fork points are computed against.
                              [default: main]
  --export TEXT               Where the annotation export lands (default:
                              beside the store).
  --on-conflict [error|skip]  An id that already exists refuses, or is skipped
                              and reported.  [default: error]
  --embed                     Recompute vectors after the rebuild (a final-
                              state pass).
  --format [text|json]        text for people, json for scripts.  [default:
                              text]
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
commands.docs:
Usage: coderadar docs [OPTIONS] [NAME]

  Print a reference document bundled with this install.

  Run without NAME to list the bundled references. `coderadar docs query-
  language` prints the query language and every selectable field.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
commands.git:
Usage: coderadar git [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Git helpers: blame, is-clean, diff.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  blame     Show git blame for a file (author per line).
  diff      Show files changed between two commits.
  is-clean  Check if the git worktree is clean.
commands.skills:
Usage: coderadar skills [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Agent skill packs bundled with this install.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  install  Copy the bundled skills into agent discovery directories.
  list     List the bundled skills and what triggers them.
  show     Print one bundled SKILL.md verbatim.
commands.get-smells:
Usage: coderadar get-smells [OPTIONS]

  Code-smell findings (MCP coderadar_get_smells).

Options:
  --entity-id TEXT      Only findings for this entity.
  --rule-id TEXT        Only findings of this rule.
  --strictness TEXT     strict | normal | loose  [default: normal]
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.find-clones:
Usage: coderadar find-clones [OPTIONS]

  Duplicated code, token-level (MCP coderadar_find_clones).

Options:
  --min-lines INTEGER     [default: 10]
  --min-similarity FLOAT  [default: 0.8]
  --max-groups INTEGER    [default: 100]
  --format [text|json]    text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
commands.find-scaffolding:
Usage: coderadar find-scaffolding [OPTIONS]

  TODO markers, placeholder bodies, temp files (MCP
  coderadar_find_scaffolding).

Options:
  --include-secrets       Also scan for hard-coded secrets.
  --max-findings INTEGER  [default: 100]
  --format [text|json]    text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
commands.exclude:
Usage: coderadar exclude [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage `[project] exclude` patterns in `.coderadar.toml`.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  add     Add PATTERN to `[project] exclude` (takes effect on next...
  list    Show user-configured excludes plus the built-in baseline.
  remove  Remove PATTERN from `[project] exclude`.
commands.load-snapshot:
Usage: coderadar load-snapshot [OPTIONS] SNAPSHOT

  Cold-start the in-memory graph from a Macrame ledger file.

Options:
  --root TEXT  Project root used with analyze (entity ids are path-keyed)
  --help       Show this message and exit.
commands.store-repair:
Usage: coderadar store-repair [OPTIONS]

  Report load-blocking rows and retire what is safely retireable.

  Prints live v1-leftover and unreadable counts, retires the v1 rows so the
  next cold load succeeds â€” an instant fix without reindexing. With --delete,
  removes the store file so the next analyze starts clean.

Options:
  --db TEXT  Path to the Macrame store file (default: the project's).
  --delete   Delete the store file outright instead of repairing (last resort:
             unreadable rows cannot be retired, only dropped).
  --help     Show this message and exit.
commands.history:
Usage: coderadar history [OPTIONS] FILE

  Every content FILE ever had, newest first (P3 content spine).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.revise-annotation:
Usage: coderadar revise-annotation [OPTIONS] ID BODY

  Supersede annotation/comment ID; BODY '-' reads stdin (P6a).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.retire-annotation:
Usage: coderadar retire-annotation [OPTIONS] ID

  Soft-retire annotation/comment ID, audit trail kept (P6a).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.comments-on:
Usage: coderadar comments-on [OPTIONS] TARGET

  Every comment version on TARGET, newest first (P6a).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.annotation-history:
Usage: coderadar annotation-history [OPTIONS] ID

  Every version of annotation ID, newest first (P6a).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.comment-history:
Usage: coderadar comment-history [OPTIONS] ID

  Every version of comment ID, newest first (P6a).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.module-children:
Usage: coderadar module-children [OPTIONS] MODULE_ID

  A module's contents (MCP coderadar_module_children).

Options:
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.resolve:
Usage: coderadar resolve [OPTIONS] NAME

  Framework references: routes (`/users/:id`), `*Model` / `*View` names (MCP
  coderadar_resolve).

Options:
  --limit INTEGER       [default: 5]
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.diagnose:
Usage: coderadar diagnose [OPTIONS]

  Show unresolved references or ambiguous edges.

Options:
  --unresolved      Show all unresolved references
  --low-confidence  List edges below min_confidence
  --help            Show this message and exit.
commands.resolve-framework:
Usage: coderadar-rs resolve-framework NAME [LIMIT]

  Resolve a framework reference (route or conventional name).

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
commands.reindex:
Usage: coderadar reindex [OPTIONS]

  Bring the index up to date (MCP coderadar_reindex).

Options:
  --full                Walk the whole tree instead of re-parsing only changed
                        files.
  --exclude TEXT        One-shot exclusion pattern (gitignore syntax),
                        repeatable; merged with [project] exclude for this run
                        only. Implies --full.
  --with-embeddings     Also compute embeddings for search-similar.
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.sync-git:
Usage: coderadar-rs sync-git REPO [OPTIONS]

  Sync the graph with the repository's current commit.

Options:
  --store TEXT        Store file to write.
  --parent-ref TEXT   Trunk ref.  [default: main]
  --no-catch-up       Skip merged-commit catch-up.
  --source TEXT       Observation source.  [default: watch]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
commands.migrate-to-commit-time:
Usage: coderadar migrate-to-commit-time [OPTIONS]

  Build a commit-time store from a repository's git history (P5a.5, DR-41).

Options:
  --repo TEXT           Git repository to migrate (history is read from git;
                        the working tree is never touched).  [required]
  --store TEXT          Destination store file (a new commit-time store; the
                        old store is never touched). Re-runs resume per
                        branch.  [required]
  --branches TEXT       Comma-separated branches to migrate (default: every
                        local branch, trunk first). The trunk is prepended
                        when missing and present â€” branch reads fall back to
                        trunk rows.
  --parent-ref TEXT     Trunk ref branch fork points are computed against.
                        [default: main]
  --no-embed            Skip the single compute_embeddings pass over the final
                        state.
  --no-verify           Skip the per-branch verify_history coverage sweep.
  --format [text|json]  text for people, json for scripts.  [default: text]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
commands.lsp:
Usage: coderadar-rs lsp COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Live language-server resolution.

Commands:
  status  Report whether LSP resolution is enabled and configured
  definition LANGUAGE FILE LINE COL  Ask for the definition at a position
  override LANGUAGE FILE LINE COL CONFIDENCE  Preview an override decision

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
